titleZh: 单元复习:万圣节派对计划
goalZh: 把爱好、能力、邀请、计划和约时间地点串起来,和朋友一起商量一次活动
canDoZh: 能和朋友一起商量一次活动:谁去、穿什么、带什么、几点在哪儿集合

newItems.noteZh: 10 月 31 日;重音在最后 Hal-lo-WEEN;常见活动是扮装(dress up)和要糖(trick-or-treat)。
万圣节扮装:wear a costume;别和 custom(习俗)混。
scary 是东西"吓人",scared 是人"害怕";美式读 /ˈskeri/。
a 读 /æ/;美国人一听你来自成都,很可能马上说 Pandas!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hey, you guys! Do you want to come to my Halloween party on Saturday?
lines.zh: 嘿,大家!周六想不想来我的万圣节派对?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Me too! Do we have to wear costumes?
lines.zh: 我也去!我们得穿扮装的衣服吗?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Lei, what are you going to be?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm going to be a panda. I'm from Chengdu!
lines.zh: 我要扮大熊猫。我可是从成都来的!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: And my costume is going to be really scary!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Great! And who can cook? We need food.
lines.zh: 太好了!对了,谁会做饭?我们得准备吃的。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: I'm going to cook Mexican food.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And I can cook really spicy Sichuan food!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Let's meet here on Saturday at seven.
lines.zh: 那我们周六七点在这儿集合吧。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sounds good! We don't really have Halloween parties in Chengdu. I can't wait!
lines.zh: 好啊!我们成都不怎么开万圣节派对。好期待啊!

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:爱好、能力、邀请、计划、约时间
grammar.bodyZh: 这个单元学的几种说法,商量一次活动时会一起用上:① 爱好:like / love / hate + 动词-ing(I love taking pictures.);② 能力:can / can't + 动词原形(I can cook. / I can't swim.);③ 邀请:Do you want to + 动词原形?,答应说 Sounds good! / I'm in!,拒绝说 Sorry, I can't. I have to…,再加一句 Maybe next time?;④ 计划:be going to + 动词原形(I'm going to be a panda.);⑤ 提议:Let's + 动词原形,或者 How about + 时间、地点?。记住:can、have to、going to、Let's 后面都接动词原形,不加 -s、-ing。发音:兴奋的时候语调起伏更大,It's going to be really fun! 重音落在 fun 上。

examples.text: I can cook really spicy food.
Do you want to come to my party?
It's going to be really fun!

examples.zh: 我们七点在这儿集合吧。
